headline: Questions everyone asks first
subheadline: Can't find what you're looking for? Drop us a note — real engineers reply.

items.question: Can I switch plans later?
items.answer: Yes, upgrade or downgrade any time from your account settings. Changes prorate to the day, so you're never paying for capacity you're not using.

items.question: What happens if my project outgrows the plan limits?
items.answer: We email you when you hit 80% of any limit. Most teams upgrade once; a small handful exceed Scale and move to a custom contract — usually a one-week conversation, not a multi-month enterprise sales cycle.

items.question: Do you offer a free tier?
items.answer: Not currently. Solo is $19/mo with a 14-day trial — long enough to ship a real project and decide. We'd rather charge a fair price and stay in business than offer a sub-sustainable free tier we'd have to take away later.

items.question: How is this different from Vercel or Netlify?
items.answer: We're edge-first by default (every static asset cached at 300+ POPs, no opt-in). Pricing is per-project, not per-seat — you don't pay more when your team grows. And support is real engineers, not a Zendesk queue.

items.question: Can I self-host?
items.answer: The runtime is open source and self-hostable. The control plane (deploys, rollback, observability) is hosted. If you need everything on-prem, the Scale plan includes a self-hosted control plane license.

items.question: Do you offer educational or non-profit discounts?
items.answer: Yes — 50% off Team for verified students, educators, and registered non-profits. Email hi@example.com with proof and we'll set it up the same day.
